title: BUGFIX — Achiri Ollama timeout 60s → 130s (measured 115s off-peak)
rationale: Background benchmark confirmed: qwen3:4b with 4409-char Achiri system prompt takes 115.87s even with no pipeline competition. Sprint 1459 set timeout at 60s — too low. Sprint 1464 added graceful Derja retry message on timeout, but users still get a failed response for a perfectly valid model invocation. Fix: increase Ollama timeout to 130s (15s headroom over measured worst-case). Typing loop (Sprint 1460) keeps UX active during the wait.
success_criteria: qwen3:4b 115s off-peak response completes within timeout

tasks.description: agents/achiri/index.ts: change AbortController timeout from 60_000 to 130_000
